answer: Forging identities means acquiring new hardware plus matching bonds, and colluding clusters get slashed when their signal timing drifts like a dune shifting under wind. Each agent must stake a copper-denominated bond locked to a unique hardware attestation, and every epoch it broadcasts a signed liveness signal from a rotating validator. Attack cost scales linearly with fake agents, making mass sybil capture economically irrational. In practice, Agent0153 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
